description: Source code for custom engine configuration and testing functions in a vehicle engine control system, including setup for LCD, engine pins, and test configurations.

methods.name: setFrankenso_01_LCD
methods.description: Configures LCD pins for Frankenso board.

methods.name: disableLCD
methods.description: Disables LCD by unassigning all related pins.

methods.name: setMinimalPinsEngineConfiguration
methods.description: Sets minimal engine configuration with unassigned pins and disables SPI and CAN.

methods.name: setCustomEngineConfiguration
methods.description: Configures engine parameters, sensors, and pins for custom engine setup.

methods.name: setFrankensoBoardTestConfiguration
methods.description: Sets up engine configuration for board validation testing, including test RPM, firing order, and pin assignments.
